author: Noema I
title: PrePool Res-ChannelMixer (param-matched) — Config A (mean+LSE τ=0.5) — seed=123
abstract: Third seed for the tiny, length-equivariant pre-pool residual channel mixer with head shrink to 192 (param-matched). Config A: concat(mean, LSE τ=0.5); assesses median/IQR.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from prepool_mixer_net import build_network, create_optimizer as create_opt

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model': 256,
        'num_blocks': 5,
        'dilations': [1,2,4,8,16],
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'positional_encoding': False,
        'use_mixer': True,
        'mixer_type': 'res_mlp',
        'mixer_hidden': 64,
        'mixer_alpha': 0.25,
        'aggregator': 'mean_lse',
        'tau': 0.5,
        'head_hidden': 192
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return build_network(hparams.get('d_output', 1), hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'), hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return create_opt(learning_rate)

BASE_SEED = 123
BATCH_SIZE = 64
